name: Quiet for fifteen minutes holds back mumbles, then lets them go
why: PLAN.md §2 check 12 and BEHAVIORS.md §3.3: "be quiet for fifteen minutes" is quiet(15); talk still reaches the brain but its mumble is dropped, agent inputs don't reach it, and after 15 minutes both come back. A classifier that answers the wrong way, more minutes for "you can talk again" or 0 for "be quiet", has its quiet call dropped by the action, so the 15 minutes neither restart nor end early

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|excited|curious, word: hi|hello) dropped (action)

chatty: agent started → react(feeling: curious, word: hmm|what|oh|okay|code|more|wow|hi|none)
